items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Skitch has been a pianist and musical director with many of America’s leading artists including Bing Crosby, Kate Smith and Frank Sinatra.

ctx.x: Skitch Henderson was born Lyle Russell Cedric Henderson on January 27, 1918 in Birmingham, England. His family immigrated to the Midwest where he began his career in music playing piano in roadhouses with territory bands. His accomplishments since then are legendary. Skitch has been a pianist and musical director with many of America’s leading artists including Bing Crosby, Kate Smith and Frank Sinatra. Skitch was interviewed at his home in New Milford, Connecticut on October 31, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
